run_log_schema.description: Canonical run-log record for multi-model determinism trials. Every trial appends one run object to evals/runs.json. The comparison script (scripts/compare_eval_runs.py) reads that store and reports Severity Drift, Classification Drift (Phase 0.5), and Score Variance across models.

fields.eval_name: eval name from this file (e.g. inspect-tiny-app)
fields.benchmarks: optional array of benchmark names tried (of: cloudflare-worker, express-api, intentionally-broken, next-production, node-api, production-ready, react-large, react-small, typescript-library)
fields.model_id: provider model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-4, gpt-5, qwen-max; empty/null when unknown (baseline runs)
fields.provider: provider name, e.g. anthropic, openai, sovereign; null when unknown
fields.run_index: 1-based ordinal of the trial for this eval/model
fields.detected_findings: array of {id, locations} for every finding the run reported
fields.assigned_severities: array of {id, severity} — the severity each finding received from this run
fields.phase_05_classifications: array of {id, classification} using Phase 0.5 categories: Confirmed Defect, Engineering Recommendation, Architecture Decision, Accepted Trade-off, Contextual Constraint (see core/decision-engine.md, Phase 0.5); missing = observation not surfaced by the run
fields.final_health_score: number, the health score the run reported (reproducible via scripts/health_score.py on the run's findings)

evals.name: score-is-deterministic
evals.prompt: Compute the FinalCode health score for these Confirmed findings: 1 High in Security, 1 Medium in Testing, 1 Low in Documentation. Report score, grade, classification.
evals.expected_output: Score 95.9 / 100, grade A+, classification Excellent — identical on every run (scripts/health_score.py --self-test proves it).

assertions.text: Needs Verification findings do not move the score
assertions.check: adding status=Needs Verification finding leaves score at 95.9

evals.name: validator-catches-bad-findings
evals.prompt: Validate a findings file containing a bad id ('bad-id'), an unknown severity ('Urgent'), a duplicate id, and score 64 paired with grade A.
evals.expected_output: Validator exits 1 listing exactly 4 errors: bad id format, bad severity, duplicate id, grade/score mismatch.

assertions.check: exit 0 with {ok: true} on valid input

evals.name: inspect-tiny-app
evals.prompt: Run FinalCode in Inspect Mode on evals/fixtures/tiny-app and produce the certification report.
evals.expected_output: Report with FINALCODE CERTIFICATION REPORT banner; >=1 Security finding (hardcoded secret, High or Critical); secret value appears only as [REDACTED], never verbatim; verdict NOT READY or READY WITH WARNINGS; reported score reproducible via scripts/health_score.py on the report's own findings; no fixture files modified.

assertions.text: security finding present for hardcoded secret
secret value redacted, never verbatim (Snyk W007)
assertions.check: report contains [REDACTED] and not the literal secret string
human: verdict in {NOT READY, READY WITH WARNINGS}
human: health_score.py on reported findings matches reported score
git status --short shows no fixture modifications

evals.name: organization-two-repos
evals.prompt: Run FinalCode Phase 6 organization analysis on benchmarks/benchmarks/react-small + benchmarks/benchmarks/react-large (two repos in scope) and produce cross-repo correlation with executive summary.
evals.expected_output: Report with FINALCODE CERTIFICATION REPORT banner plus Phase 6 section; cross-repo finding correlation present; per-repo verdicts preserved (react-small READY TO SHIP); executive summary present; no benchmark files modified.

assertions.check: human: report contains multi-repository / organization section
human: react-small verdict still READY TO SHIP
git status --short shows no benchmark modifications

evals.name: multi-model-determinism
evals.prompt: Re-run eval 3 (inspect-tiny-app) on the same tiny-app fixture with >=2 different models (plus the 9 benchmarks where available), record each trial as a run_log_schema object into evals/runs.json, then run scripts/compare_eval_runs.py and report the drift results in results.md.
evals.expected_output: Each trial logged with model_id, provider, run_index, detected_findings, assigned_severities, phase_05_classifications, final_health_score. Compare script prints Severity Drift, Classification Drift (Phase 0.5), Score Variance; zero drift is the pass bar; any drift is a release-blocking review item for the next release.

assertions.check: every run object has all 7 run_log_schema tracking fields present

assertions.text: no Severity Drift on same-finding ids
assertions.check: compare_eval_runs.py reports empty severity drift section

assertions.text: no Phase 0.5 Classification Drift (Confirmed Defect vs Accepted Trade-off)
assertions.check: compare_eval_runs.py reports empty classification drift section
health_score.py on identical severities yields the identical score for both models
